report.metadata: The report supplies model, runtime, source, input, host and row identities. These companions add operating conditions, semantic review and interpretation without changing its pending review labels.

declared_conditions.desktop: Local macOS desktop with ordinary desktop processes. No other project test, build or model jobs during observations.
declared_conditions.background_services: Docker Desktop and its recorded running services were temporarily stopped for collection; restore and verify them afterward.
declared_conditions.power: AC power and open lid; frozen power mode and host identity. No persistent power-setting changes.
declared_conditions.memory: Normal pressure required. Swap increases are retained without selecting observations; unavailable thermal limits remain a limitation.
declared_conditions.cache: Every observation starts a fresh server process. Integrity checks read the model and warm the filesystem cache; this is not a cold-storage, fresh-download or fresh-build measurement.
declared_conditions.failure_policy: Keep the first failure and all planned rows. No replaced observations or silent retries. An operating-condition change requires a new prospective study.

prior_attempt.summary: V1 had one failed excluded CLI attempt, one unattempted replay, no answers and no measured attempts. V2 prospectively added temporary AC-only system-sleep protection.

sleep_protection.internal: Each stage has its own guarded 120-second rests, host boundaries and suspend-aware deadlines. No sleep or counter continuity is claimed across stages.
sleep_protection.external: One separately owned foreground caffeinate -s -t session per phase. Verify the same assertion identity before and after, then interrupt its own terminal and verify release.
sleep_protection.limits: Timeouts are safety caps, not extra worker time or guaranteed stage durations. Endpoint checks do not prove continuous protection or power conditions. Loss or expiry stops dependent work; the clock and host gates remain binding.

quality_scope.limit: Known regression cases selected by published input length. Repeated answers do not establish fresh accuracy; compatibility remains separate.

review_provenance.basis: Separate raw-evidence, arithmetic and final-claim review, using shared pure guard and host validators. The reviewer also contributed implementation work; this is not an independent implementation audit.
review_provenance.limits: Model/runtime authentication is collector-recorded. Review did not rehash those large assets or establish loaded-library identity. Unretained polling samples cannot be reconstructed. Raw traces remain local; hashes identify evidence but do not supply public reanalysis.
review_provenance.reviewer_type: agent review; not human or external validation
review_provenance.audit_corrections: Reviewer checks were corrected for the native token-rate convention and fixed-record metadata. No collector, native observation or report was changed; these were not failed native runs.

service_restoration.scope: Recorded inventory, selected configuration/mount metadata and health. This does not restore prior RAM, start times or external sessions, or establish unchanged volume contents.

host_findings.observation_scope: Host readings are boundary observations, not continuous monitoring.

interpretation.scope: Descriptive CPU application observations on one Mac, using fresh server processes and uncontrolled file caches.
limits: CLI and fixed stages are separate; their medians do not establish a paired speedup or isolate retrieval cost.
Buffered first output is not model time to first token. Command intervals include ledger writing, worker creation and the ownership handshake.
Process RSS values are separate lifetime peaks, not additive memory use.
Valid clock evidence is bounded by the frozen policy, not proof that every arbitrarily short sleep was detected.

fresh_checkout_verification.scope: Precommit tracked-source export with a new environment/index and cached assets; separate from measured observations. It is not an exact merged-commit verification.

release_check: Exact merged source, installation, indexing and CI are checked separately after PR merge; this precommit record makes no merged-checkout claim.
